'''Capra Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in the [[Capra offworld quarter]]. It was several [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] long and its design was inspired by the wings of the [[Tayan falcon]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
